PhonePageIntro: Enter the six-digit code shown by the panel on the computer.
PhoneSectionSubtitle: Your phone on your own network: permission, pairing code, who is connected and which address the panel waits on. Traffic goes over the network unencrypted — the code and the pass protect the sign-in.
PhoneLimits: Works on your own network: sign in by QR and answer the agent's question; setting tasks and managing agents are in development; it makes no external connections.
PhoneRightNote: The phone is allowed, but the phone connection did not open. Check the firewall rule below: if there is no rule, place it and the phone connection will open by itself.
PhoneNoDoor: This run does not manage the phone: there is no phone connection.
PhonePortNote: The panel waits for your phone on this port of your own network. A busy port is a refusal in words, with no silent move.
PhonePortForbiddenFormat: Port {0} is the panel server port and {1} is its fallback. The panel never takes them for the phone.
PhonePortWrongFormat: That port will not do: I will take {1} instead of {0}.
PhoneCodeFresh: The code has just been issued. Enter it on the phone while it is alive.
PhoneCodeShownAgain: This is the same code as before: enter it on the phone while it is alive.
PhoneCodeFailed: Could not show a code: the phone connection is closed. Allow the phone and try again.
PhoneDevicesEmpty: The phone has not connected yet: there are no paired devices.
PhoneForgetFailed: Could not unlink the device: it is still in the list.
PhoneAddressNote: The address comes from DHCP and may change: then scan the code again.
PhoneAddressNoAddresses: There is no suitable address: there is nothing to show the phone.
PhoneAddressPickedFormat: You chose the address {0} — the phone will find the panel there.
PhoneAddressFailed: Could not remember the choice: the address was not saved.
PhoneSeenFormat: The phone was last in touch: {0}
PhoneSeenNever: The phone has not been in touch yet.
PhoneQrNote: The QR code carries the address and port: the camera opens the phone page straight away. Type the six-digit code on the phone.
PhoneQrNoAddress: No QR drawn: there is no address, so there is nothing to encode.
PhoneQrFailed: The QR could not be drawn: this address did not encode.
PhoneQrMasked: The address is masked in this frame, so the code here is a sample. Your own address is shown to you on screen.
PhoneToggleFailed: Could not switch the phone: the settings were not saved.
PhoneForgetAllFailedLog: the phone is off, but the devices could not be unlinked: the pass file was not saved
TipPhoneShowCodeButton: Show the six-digit code for signing in from the phone
TipPhoneForgetDeviceButton: Unlink this device — the others keep working
FirewallNote: For the phone to connect, Windows must let the incoming connection through. The panel adds one narrow rule: private profile only, this port only, this program only, local subnet only.
FirewallStateReadyFormat: The rule exists: incoming on port {0} is allowed for this program.
FirewallStateAbsent: No rule: Windows will not let the phone's incoming connection through.
FirewallStateOther: A rule with the panel's name exists, but not the one the panel adds: remove it first.
FirewallStateSeveral: More than one rule carries the panel's name: that should not happen, remove them.
FirewallStateUnknownFormat: The firewall state could not be read (this is not "no rule"): {0}
FirewallNoDoor: This run does not manage the firewall.
FirewallBeforeAddFormat: The panel will now add a firewall rule: incoming TCP on port {0} — this program only, local subnet only. Windows will ask for confirmation.
FirewallBeforeRemove: The panel will now remove its firewall rule. Windows will ask for confirmation.
FirewallDoneAddFormat: Rule added: incoming on port {0} is allowed.
FirewallRefused: Nothing changed: Windows confirmation was not given.
FirewallNotRemoved: The rule could not be removed: it is still there.
FirewallPortUnusableFormat: No rule is added for port {0}: the panel does not use that port.
FirewallTipButton: Change the Windows firewall rule (Windows will ask for confirmation)
FirewallAddedLogFormat: firewall: rule added (port {0}, private profile, local subnet)
FirewallRefusedLog: firewall: change cancelled — Windows confirmation was not given
FirewallNoRightLog: firewall: not managed — panel check may not change machine rules

PhonePageChooseAll: Choose an answer for every question.
PhonePageAnsweredAgain: The answer has already been sent — it is not sent twice.
